BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION SP2023)
CLASS: B.ARCH   SEMESTER : II
BRANCH: ARCHITECTURE   SESSION : SP/2023

SUBJECT: AR151 ADVANCED BUILDING MATERIALS
TIME: 02 HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


   CO BL
Q.1(a) What are different forms of aluminum? Describe each of them with suitable example.     [2] 1 2
Q.1(b) Enumerates the various copper alloys in details?                                                               [3] 1 1


Q.2(a) What is an alloy? How is it formed? [2] 1 2
Q.2(b) Mention the characteristics of Aluminum as an important building material. [3] 1 2


Q.3(a) Write short notes on:
a. Duralumin
b. Naval brass
[2] 2 1
Q.3(b) What are the characteristics of a good tile? [3] 5 2


Q.4(a) Give reasons
a. the floor tiles should be hard and durable.
b. The tiles are dried under shade.
[2] 5 3
Q.4(b) What are difference in the requirements of floor tiles and wall tiles? In what places
would you consider tiling the walls?
[3] 5 4


Q.5(a) Write short notes on:
a. Electrolytic theory of corrosion.
b. Stress corrosion.
[2] 2 2
Q.5(b) Explain the different theories of Corrosion detailing any one of them. [3] 2 4
